prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1006; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the right-hand lane on a multi-lane roadway in Conroe, Texas, when the vehicle moved left to change lanes and made contact with the side of the vehicle driven by Driver 2, which was in the adjacent lane. The contact was a sideswipe along the left rear quarter panel of Driver 2's vehicle and the right front area of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder following the impact and was evaluated at the scene. Driver 2 stated that the collision happened the way Driver 1 described it, and two independent witnesses who stopped at the scene gave consistent accounts. Photographs taken at the scene show damage patterns that line up with a lateral impact of this kind, and nothing observed suggested prior damage to either vehicle. A Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time and was confirmed present by both witnesses and the responding officer. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. The shoulder complaint is consistent with the forces typically associated with a sideswipe of this nature, and no further action was taken at the scene beyond exchanging information and clearing the lanes.
